title: Frontier Space: Meridian Accord consoles (Federation-like)
description: Six console screens (ids as in fspace-std) plus a transporter screen, original per-empire ship sprites (front, side, rear, top views) with damage zones and glow anchors, planets, and a viewscreen scene. Sound pack and era are named only (no audio): era map 'tng'.
